scope: CORRECTION: m | Q is an EXISTENCE criterion (U is some m-th power, m roots, and the choice moves the class) -- the CANONICITY criterion is the per-factor m | n_j r_j, which makes the root an explicit integer-exponent product. Both agree on xi, so every merged lattice verdict stands and the Lean is unaffected; only the label was wrong. Under the corrected criterion a canonical representative still EXISTS at every m | 24 (lattice membership, non-vacuous: the five-term relations have index 3120 in Z^23 and xi is not among them), with an explicit m = 24 witness verified to satisfy per-factor divisibility and to differ from xi by a relation. Does NOT produce eps_m values at m >= 3 -- but it makes that next increment well-posed.
